headline: Lead DevOps Engineer | SaaS Platforms | AWS
page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead DevOps Engineer
summary_html: DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and production support, partnering closely with development teams to improve SaaS delivery and day-to-day engineering productivity. Hands-on background in CloudBees CI (Jenkins Enterprise), Jenkins Pipelines, Python, Groovy shared libraries, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Terraform, and Ansible. Builds reusable delivery workflows and self-service platform automation with AWS and Azure. Owns technical delivery from requirements and planning through implementation, rollout, documentation, and operational support.

achievements.text: Built reusable pipelines, onboarding APIs, and deployment guidance that let application teams deliver services with less platform intervention.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins and JFrog tooling; developed shared libraries for consistent image versioning and artifact publication.
Combined Kubernetes delivery, infrastructure automation, observability, and incident response to improve service readiness and release confidence.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Owned platform deliveries for SaaS-style application services, translating developer requirements into implementation plans, reusable automation, rollout criteria, and production support procedures.
Built AWS-first CI/CD workflows with CodePipeline and GitHub Actions for Java and Node.js microservices, standardizing build, test, image publication, and deployment stages with development teams.
Delivered reusable Terraform modules and EKS environment patterns so teams could provision consistent infrastructure through reviewed changes; supported Azure delivery environments.
Containerized microservices with Docker and deployed versioned Helm releases, aligning application configuration, service dependencies, health checks, and rollback procedures across environments.
Automated provisioning, diagnostics, and recovery tasks in Python and Bash; maintained Linux build agents and distributed execution capacity for concurrent engineering workloads.
Integrated secrets handling, Terraform validation, image checks, and approval gates into developer workflows to detect release risks before production deployment.
Operated EKS infrastructure for Milvus and GPU-enabled services, partnering with application teams on capacity, workload isolation, private connectivity, and production readiness.
Coordinated high-priority incident response and release support, converting recurring failures into automation, runbooks, and actionable engineering improvements.
Applied AI-assisted techniques to draft automation, explain pipeline failures, and develop troubleshooting guidance, validating generated changes through review and testing.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Partnered with SaaS development teams to resolve build, container, and deployment failures and simplify daily delivery across AWS and Azure environments.
Operated Linux and Windows build-agent pools with reusable runner templates and execution policies, improving consistency for parallel CI workloads.
Modernized Jenkins workflows into reusable GitLab CI templates while preserving application build, test, artifact publication, and release requirements.
Standardized Docker images, Kubernetes deployment patterns, branch protections, and image-validation checks to make releases easier for developers to troubleshoot.
Organized artifact feeds and repository consumption patterns and coached engineers on merge workflows, pipeline ownership, and environment promotion.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Built Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines for cloud-hosted microservices, integrating Maven builds, automated checks, ECR image publication, and Kubernetes delivery.
Delivered AWS infrastructure with Terraform and CloudFormation; supported Azure workloads while keeping application delivery patterns reusable.
Implemented ArgoCD GitOps workflows and Helm packaging for EKS services, giving developers version-controlled deployments and clear rollback paths.
Maintained Linux build runners and automated environment configuration with Ansible and scripts to keep build dependencies and execution environments consistent.
Published versioned binaries and container images to shared repositories and integrated SonarQube feedback into engineering workflows.
Partnered with distributed development teams on release failures and service reliability, using CloudWatch dashboards, backup controls, and operational documentation.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Administered CloudBees CI (Jenkins Enterprise), JFrog Artifactory, and Xray for SaaS product engineering, supporting reliable builds, secure artifact storage, and release execution.
Developed Groovy Jenkins shared libraries for image versioning and artifact publishing, allowing developers to reuse tested pipeline steps across services.
Developed Python FastAPI services integrating Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog to automate project onboarding and provide self-service access to delivery workflows.
Partnered with microservice developers on build dependencies, unit and integration test stages, test-result publication, and repeatable promotion of release artifacts.
Provisioned AWS-first application infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, with Azure supporting delivery integrations.
Authored Docker and Helm deployment patterns for Kubernetes services, including payment-platform workloads, to standardize configuration and application rollout.
Built Python Prometheus exporters and highly available monitoring stacks with Ansible, Grafana, and Node Exporter to expose application and platform health.
Worked with developers during production incidents, defect isolation, and sprint retrospectives; turned recurring support issues into platform fixes and reusable guidance.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Partnered with application developers and engineering stakeholders on CI/CD improvements for shared software services, translating roadmap priorities into delivery work.
Built Jenkins and Maven delivery workflows for REST microservices across test, security-validation, UAT, and production environments.
Packaged Kubernetes applications with Helm and managed namespaces, services, and configuration for repeatable deployments across shared clusters.
Supported AWS-first infrastructure and Azure integrations, automating Linux configuration and troubleshooting compute, databases, load balancing, and secrets access.
Implemented ELK operational visibility and documented environment and release procedures to help developers diagnose application and platform issues.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Built CI/CD workflows for API, database, and UI components with development teams, standardizing build dependencies and release promotion for shared application services.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure through Terraform and automated Linux configuration and deployment with Ansible, supporting Azure environments.
Maintained build agents and Python and shell automation to keep software builds repeatable and simplify infrastructure administration.
Defined Git branching practices, versioned artifacts, and environment-specific configuration so developers could promote consistent releases from development through production.
